decisions.reason: Retaining the 0-ohm I2C series resistors does not change the interboard connector partition, types, pinout, or pin-order policy.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY retaining R10 and R11 as 0-ohm resistors and recording their I2C voltage-spike-protection justification.
The decision concerns I2C series resistors and does not alter USB enumeration, connector sourceability, data lines, or their interboard route.
The retained I2C resistors do not affect the 5V boost converter, its enable control, default state, or powered loads.
The I2C resistor-retention decision does not alter the selected addressable LED family or its data GPIO.
